title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
script:
Forty five billion dollars. That is the size of the compute deal Anthropic and Nscale are discussing.
If the agreement goes through, it would rank among the latest giant compute deals Anthropic has struck.
The company has spent the past year locking down massive infrastructure partnerships to expand its operations.
TechCrunch reported on the ongoing discussions between both firms regarding the hardware expansion.
Will these escalating hardware investments strain global data center capacity further?
